serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Lady Annalie: Sorry, I’m late!{{punch}} Bot: Hello, Annalie! How are you feeling? Lady Annalie: I’m ok! Melissa: Didn’t I tell you to stay home? Lady Annalie: Sorry, but I went to the doctor and he told me I can come if I keep it easy. Melissa: Really? Lady Annalie: I knew you would be doubtful so I came with a receipt! #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: You do realise that it wouldn’t be the end of the world if you missed one meeting, right? #Cashier.Face.normal #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: Sorry, but I need my daily dose of fooling around~ Melissa: There really is no hope for you. #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Bot: The most important thing is that you feel alright, I’m really glad! You: Me too! Since it’s my fault the crash happened in the first place… Lady Annalie: Thanks, guys. It means a lot. Lady Annalie: Especially you, Melissa. I was really surprised when you came to my shop to help out. #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: You don’t need to mention it. I just had some time to spare, that’s all. #Cashier.Face.normal #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: So how about you come again soon? I would want to pay you back a little~ Melissa: I would rather not. Don’t get ahead of yourself. Lady Annalie: That’s the Melissa I remember~ So cold on the outside~ Bot: Are you implying that she is any different on the inside? Lady Annalie: I’m not implying, that’s the truth~ Bot: For me personally, that’s a big surprise, but I guess if Annalie says so, it’s gotta be true! #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: I really regret my decision. #Cashier.Face.normal #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: Don’t say that, Melissa. We are only teasing you a little now, but I really think of you as a good friend. #Cashier.Face.shocked Melissa: … #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: You all are just a bunch of weirdos. #Cashier.Face.normal Melissa: Can we start bowling now? I think I'm getting sick from all this sugar-coating. Bot: Alright! Let’s start! You: Once again. Where are your bowling shoes, Annalie?! Lady Annalie: This again? I think the last time I showed just how good I can bowl on my platforms. Why do I even bother… She’s a lost cause… Bot: Do we split into teams this time around too? Lady Annalie: Fine by me. We got two world-class players and two nobodies. Ideal for matchmaking. Bot: So it’s me and {f_playerName} versus you and Melissa! #bot.Expression.clear Lady Annalie: Woah, woah! Hold your horses! Lady Annalie: We did that the last time, and it’s the most obvious thing to do, yes, but is it the most interesting? Lady Annalie: How about we put a little twist on it and change things around? Bot: W-Well, I have nothing against you, Annalie, but I don’t know how I feel about betraying {f_playerName} like that… Lady Annalie: Betraying? It’s just a game! Lady Annalie: Come on, it’s going to be fun! Bot: Alright, I guess. It’s just one game. You: It looks like we are on the same team, Melissa. Melissa: Yes, it does. You: Do you think we have a chance to beat them? Melissa: If you don’t fuck it up, yes. You: W-Why so harsh… Melissa: Last time your team lost because of you, remember? You: That’s true… Melissa: I don’t really care that much about winning, though, so you can take it slow if you want. You: No need. I will be doing my best. It’s not like I don’t like winning. Melissa is a little more laid back than {f_botName}. Maybe with someone less stress-inducing on my team, my throws will be better. This team might just work. Let’s check up on the other one. #Annalie_Outside.face.suprised #bot.Expression.happy Bot: Now Annalie, turn your hip 17mm to the right. Lady Annalie: L-Like this? Bot: Rotate your calf by 13 degrees. Lady Annalie: Got it! Bot: Left foot 24mm to the front. Lady Annalie: I feel like we are playing Twister, you know? Lady Annalie: Are you sure this will help me throw better? Bot: Yes. The correct form is one the most important things. {{wi}}Now relax your spine muscles. Lady Annalie: S-Spine what?! I don’t think a normal human being is capable of that! They look like they are having fun. You: Melissa, do you have some- Melissa: I don’t. You: You didn’t even let me finish my question… Melissa: Fine. Say your piece. You: Do you have any tips for me? Melissa: I don’t. You: … Melissa: Don’t look at me like that. My processing power isn’t even a fraction of what that freak bot of yours possesses. You: Didn’t you help Annalie though? Melissa: She was a total newbie. Teaching someone the basics of bowling is a completely different thing than calculating an optimal bowling posture and then implementing it. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.SmileClosed+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm #bot.Expression.clear Lady Annalie: {f_botName}... I don’t think I’m able to throw the bowling ball like this… I’m barely able to keep my balance… Melissa: Looks like someone forgot to take into account that Annalie has no brawn whatsoever. Lady Annalie: Gyah!{{punch}} You: There goes her first fall of the day… Melissa: {f_botName}’s plan didn’t work, so we should be fine. You: Let’s get this game going. That’s enough yoga for you, Annalie. Lady Annalie: I agree… Bot: Annalie. I need your core muscles to grow by 20% for our next game together. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww Lady Annalie: Listen, woman, you have some unrealistic expectations! Says the girl that calls herself ‘picky’... #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Normal Lady Annalie: Don’t worry, {f_botName}, we are going to win this. Don’t you remember? I had more points than Anon the last time we played. #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.happy Bot: You are completely right! I forgot how useless he was! You: … You: Who’s throwing first? Bot: I will. And like that, we started the game. It was very tight, just like the last time, but with Annalie receiving constant tips from {f_botName}, their team’s lead was growing every round. You: It doesn’t look good, Melissa. What are we going to do? Melissa: ‘We’? I’m getting strike after strike. It’s you who needs to get a grip. You: Yeah, you are right… If I throw at least one strike, it should almost completely close up the gap. Do I need to rotate the ball more? I have no idea. It’s my turn now. Time is running out and if I don’t turn things around now, it will be almost impossible to win. I need to concentrate! #Annalie_Outside.face.suprised #bot.Expression.Shock I-I did it! I don’t know what exactly I did differently, but all of the pins are down! It’s probably just luck, but this is what we needed to get back into the game! You: Did you see that, Melissa?! Melissa: Yes, I did. You: I did good, right? Melissa: Yes, yes… You: I really outdid myself with this one! Melissa: Don’t act so overly cheerful, even if we are on the same team, you are still pissing me off. You: Right, sorry… #bot.Expression.clear #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Lady Annalie: S-Say, {f_botName}. What do I need to throw to guarantee our win? Bot: Spare or strike. Lady Annalie: Y-Yeah, I don’t think I can do it. Bot: Don’t worry, he was just lucky. We still have more points than them. Bot: After me and Melissa throw, we will begin the last round. #Annalie_Outside.face.sad Bot: I don’t want to put unnecessary pressure on you, but the whole match will be decided by your throw. Lady Annalie: Thanks. {{wi}}No pressure.{{wi}} Got it. After that, {f_botName} and Melissa each got a strike, and the last round was upon us… You: Annalie, why the sour face? Lady Annalie: Do not distract me! Can’t you see that I’m about to put my very soul into this throw? #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open Lady Annalie: Bowling ball! This is the last of my hamon! Take it! Lady Annalie: … #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Melissa: Mediocre. You: Mediocre. Bot: Mediocre. #Annalie_Outside.face.sad Lady Annalie: I get it already! Lady Annalie: If it was anime, I would get a strike, but instead there are still 4 pins left! Melissa: With such positioning of pins, it’s practically impossible to get a spare. Good for us. You: Yes! We still have a chance to win! Uwah…{{wi}} {f_botName} is staring daggers into Annalie’s back… Good thing it’s not me in her place… Lady Annalie: I-I still can make it work! It’s just 4 pins! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open Lady Annalie: Here I go! Lady Annalie: … #Annalie_Outside.face.sad You: Yes! She left 2 pins! Lady Annalie: Aren’t you being too cheerful? You still would need at least a spare to win. Melissa: She’s right. You still need to throw above your average. You: Right… Bot: It’s ok. We still have a 67% chance of winning. It’s ok… #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww Lady Annalie: Oi, {f_botName}. It’s hard to believe that “it’s ok” when you are quite literally shaking in your boots! You: Calm down, everyone. It’s my turn now. Let me throw in peace. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy Lady Annalie: No problem. I will pray for your downfall in silence! You: Are the stakes really that high for you to do that?! Bot: We don’t have a whole day, please throw it already. Et tu, Brute… No matter. I will just throw the best I can! Here I go! #Annalie_Outside.face.suprised #bot.Expression.Sad Yes! Only one pin left! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Bot: No way… Our chances of winning are… 0.01%... Lady Annalie: Can’t you even hold back a little? You are playing against two girls, for Christ’s sake! You: I didn’t know that gender mattered in bowling… Melissa: Good job. If you hit that last pin, our victory will be pretty much secured. You: Yes! I will do it! Time for my last throw of the day! #Annalie_Outside.face.sad #bot.Expression.verySad You: Yes! I did it! We won! Bot: You dummy! Why did you start throwing properly when we aren’t on the same team?! Lady Annalie: He just got lucky. What a bunch of sore losers… You: Your turn, Melissa. Melissa: Right. And then, something unthinkable happened… #Annalie_Outside.face.suprised #bot.Expression.veryhappy #Cashier.Face.shocked Melissa: … #Cashier.Face.normal Melissa: I messed up. After a dozen or so perfect strikes, Melissa left a single pin on the alley… #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy Bot: With this it will be a draw! Lady Annalie: Wait, really?! Lady Annalie: That’s what you get Anon, for acting all smug! You: But I didn’t… Melissa: Sorry. You: Don’t mention it. It was wrong for me to assume that you will get a strike every time. Melissa: … #Cashier.Face.happy Melissa: It was a good game anyway. I’m happy with it being a draw. You: Me too. #bot.Expression.happy
